learningObjectives: Import and organize reusable Python modules.

activities.title: Module Map
activities.instruction: Explore how modules and packages organize Python code.

content.concept: A module is typically a Python file containing reusable code. Packages organize related modules into a directory structure.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Package Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore a simple Python project package structure.

content.concept: A project can separate application code into modules and packages so related functionality is easier to maintain and import.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Root directory containing the Python project.
Package initialization module; in modern Python, a directory can also function as a namespace package without it.

activities.title: Import Explorer
activities.instruction: Choose the import syntax that correctly accesses the required code.

content.concept: Python supports importing complete modules, selected names from modules, and modules under aliases.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: import math → import the math module
from math import sqrt → import sqrt directly
import numpy as np → import numpy using the alias np
